objective: Prove the generic VerdiWM loop can select an idle physical GPU, execute real CUDA work, verify it, archive it, and retire scratch state.
hypothesis: A bounded CUDA matrix workload completes on the leased GPU with finite output and observable physical GPU activity.
selection_reason: This is the cheapest end-to-end runtime canary before any world-model experiment is admitted.
falsification_criterion: The command fails, uses a different physical GPU, has no observed GPU activity, emits a malformed result, or exceeds its numerical error gate.
